However, controlled human clinical evidence confirming hangover prevention or faster alcohol clearance remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11QPhOyRLpLGHBHM_VFupaLV2YVPgoPEzxsykcbjsVIXgRBDwR9oZxpwh6_wJ371ceVOHrWjsH_ZBfoB1dWLs7uhPGTtc5Bs1jN1rw2VVsv0e1-UYRpX8T7pNvnf2djLkyULRUWRREiQQKs6degYUwqOLRxy9JTQ5a4UhQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXhQEq1KSLqSQKEBMQPd_sTd0XpMNEmtX4CXETrR2x_QoyavMnSmoZ7meUuTPMeZB95pSJzH9gDE2fAvX_bZi2MXAAfckq_3KWkQY8pk4EIZ5WnXDCAmLYkquSqW4TOMsZEr4fAEmp_g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF13-puvIliOkR4Fl_5cLoxXjdeyfnaZwpN3kGWFxFF7v_WFXM2v7pXNEwF8tftot1_bjeqXfPFzLv1vg_oZpnTSY53wQmv-f6ls6n6NSZc4LzoyAOZvWke-uZ_-ZzY6y4q3gGd7YPAGqE3AnBLznnZd3eCpiOi8TYijUvOvVg_i3N)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX0T3x28s349A2whLVgNVx3flIuhkLBmUCCQF9Ct6CAWaDIS9BPdVZS1QQdJ89eLVyoYBSUMN9mUNxF62XHlOn8AYSGIXLbDlNPkZ0zfkBkJXVu0aToQSKv9NeH0raZKqmXkjf9jWEjmTZhWahDcLHSMg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXnTRxKbxs2WkcZAtFXLo3hOijNO2Mcyl8oCxGTfY9nUAGnOjU2Twq_Z-M_ZiZNE99R9qyDXjI7g98PThLbcTVAECG4c-cRUxllA9xq5yF-Ra04-f9HN_RWLyGYrOV40os)
- **Bioavailability:** DHM has relatively low oral bioavailability and poor water solubility, meaning the body absorbs only a small portion of standard oral doses.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF10P5yMGMT0FI7TYECy5zXHRzUQkLn6KvwuyeEYWvQ8Je9fTd-FgNdq2pF-UErJrpS6SEbPOB3jwzR-WfXOlxHhwweKZvgJaubYk6sxVADeIlf8IKteHq4TW8oojwKDReTrPM860XJY40fqaWhmX4ze6ZFgfUUF6fxg6g8cra25NMe7Hc8MobWXE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXpd5dCCVG6hF5uXaAZLwZXwkD1hGQEDNPwL5KIfLuGRQxTyOw-eDGI7sbLX5m0ZNaIB85SnWG4Hr-ObdbZeYjekHr_RwQwW4QIyH7nzhQxtHwC7MP4RtF1a4D8Q0uoof4lC7RfoG4)
